title: EMS BTMS Communication Configuration
description: Modbus connection and device configuration for the Battery Thermal Management System (BTMS). Supports both Modbus RTU (RS485) and Modbus TCP. Controls cooling/heating to maintain cells within safe temperature range.

_schema_version.description: Schema version for migration detection. Must match the schema expected version.

connection.description: Modbus transport layer configuration. Protocol selects RTU (RS485 serial) or TCP (Ethernet).

protocol.description: Modbus transport protocol. 'rtu' uses RS485 serial, 'tcp' uses Ethernet.

slave_id.description: Modbus slave/unit ID of the BTMS device.

device.description: Serial device path for Modbus RTU. Example: /dev/ttyUSB1 or /dev/ttyS2.

baud_rate.description: Serial baud rate for Modbus RTU. Must match BTMS hardware configuration. Default: 9600.

parity.description: Serial parity for Modbus RTU. N=None, E=Even, O=Odd. Default: N.

stopbits.description: Number of serial stop bits for Modbus RTU. Default: 1.

host.description: IP address or hostname of the BTMS device for Modbus TCP.

port.description: TCP port number for Modbus TCP. Standard Modbus TCP port is 502.

device.description: BTMS device operational parameters. Defines thermal management mode and target temperature setpoint.

mode.description: Thermal management mode. 'liquid' uses liquid cooling loops; 'air' uses forced air cooling/heating.

setpoint_temp_c.description: Target battery temperature setpoint. BTMS will regulate to maintain cells at this temperature. Valid range: 15-35°C for safe operation.

timing.description: Modbus polling interval and timeout configuration for BTMS communication.

poll_interval_ms.description: How often to poll BTMS registers for temperature and status readings. Shorter intervals improve thermal control response.

timeout_ms.description: Modbus request timeout. If no response within this window, the request is retried or a fault is raised.
